args.summary: The latest deploy (v2.3.1) failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of ~18%. Rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0. Rollback completed successfully with status "rolled_out". Current incident opened to track follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 failure.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target**: Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was the latest, and it was unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions — the rollback completed successfully.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failing deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
5. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down to 0.2%.

The v2.3.1 failure still needs a root-cause investigation — that's now tracked under INC-0001.
